About the job
Help clients turn complex data into useful decisions.
Recruiting for this role ends on August 10, 2026.

Work You'll Do
Lead delivery across strategy, analytics, engineering, and adoption.

Strategy & Stakeholder Partnership
Translate business goals into an AI roadmap.

Analytics & Data Science
Build forecasting and machine learning solutions.

Software & Data Engineering
Create production-quality data pipelines and services.

People Leadership

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Clear communication, sound judgment, and technical depth.

The team
You will join a multidisciplinary AI engineering practice.

Qualifications
The role combines technical leadership and hands-on delivery.

Required:
Eight years of software or data engineering experience.

Preferred:
Experience with generative AI and cloud platforms.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program.
